captions.analyze: Paste, PDF or photos — pick country and side
captions.decision: Sign, negotiate or walk away — with reasons
captions.advisor: Ask your country — sources you can check

frames.analyze: Show Analyze with country and side already picked. Use a sample contract only — never a real client file.
frames.decision: Show Sign, negotiate or walk away with visible reasons. Do not overlay a win rate.
frames.advisor: Show a country question and official sources the user can open. Invent no court citation.
frames.cases: Show a sample case timeline with dates. No passport photo and no real evidence file.
frames.guides: Show a step-by-step guide with an official portal link visible on screen.
frames.lawyer: Show official bar and legal-aid directories. Name, rank or recommend no lawyer.
frames.languages: Show the thirteen-language list and keep the honest disclaimer as the last line.

device: Use a clean phone frame. Hide personal names, emails, real contracts and payment cards.
banned: Never overlay a win rate, a named lawyer, a ready-for-court claim or a promised court outcome.
disclaimer: NexuLex is not a law firm. These frames are product demos, not legal advice.
